name: GBPRevive
tagline: GBPRevive is an AI-powered Google Business Profile recovery and protection tool for local businesses and agencies
description: GBPRevive is an AI-powered Google Business Profile recovery and protection tool for local businesses and agencies. It scans Google Business Profiles and websites for common suspension-risk signals, including: - NAP mismatches - Duplicate listing risk - Wrong website URLs - Phone inconsistencies - Address and service-area issues - Missing business information - Noindex and canonical website problems Users get a clear risk score and practical fixes to improve appeal readiness, verification readine
